reviewItem.question: For "544aea18c32b34eac523791e7e2ef186abbd6daf: fix(ui): Cannot add an app that has both name and server destination", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether users attempt to create applications with both name and server destination specified in the UI

proposed.statement: A bug fix in the Argo CD UI allows applications to be added when both name and server destination are specified, whereas this was previously unsupported.
